notes.title: Game Development Update
notes.notes:
[p][b]Warning! To cover up the scandal of illegal experiments, the ACX Group has fully upgraded its defense deployment: it has not only intensively added mechanical sentries and mechanical hounds in various areas, with patrol ranges covering key exploration points; but also installed new homing missile systems in the Trial Arena. The lock-on attack mode will greatly raise the challenge difficulty![/b][/p][h3][b]New Awakened Warrior Online: The Veteran Hunter[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The long-range combat ace "The Veteran Hunter" officially joins the battle with his loyal hunting dog![/p][/*][*][p]He excels at precise sniping and battlefield suppression, and also comes with bow and arrow equipment suitable for multiple scenarios.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]New Arsenal: Targeted Countermeasures Against Mechanical Enemies[/b][/h3][list][*][p]"Annihilator" Series Magnetic Storm Rifles[/p][list][*][p]Core highlight: "Multi-target Strike" — a single attack can penetrate multiple enemies, doubling your efficiency against ACX cluster sentries;[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Hunter-exclusive Multi-functional Bows and Arrows[/p][list][*][p]Supports "compatibility with various types of ammunition". Whether it's Armor-Piercing Arrows, Incendiary Arrows, or Explosive Arrows, you can switch them as needed to adapt to different combat requirements;[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Secret Weapons of Eastern Ninjas[/p][list][*][p]Mysterious ninjas also bring portable shurikens (throwing stars) and kunais (daggers).[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]50+ New Items: Full Tactical Support[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Exclusive Support from Anonymous Drone Experts[/p][list][*][p]2 types of auxiliary drones that can continuously release "Boost Rays" in the air (including attack power boost, defense boost, HP Recovery Buff, etc.) to provide full-course bonuses;[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New Practical Equipment from Arms Dealers[/p][list][*][p]Flash Grenades (instantly blind a large range of units)[/p][/*][*][p]Various EMP (Electromagnetic Pulse) Weapons (directly paralyze the movement of enemy machinery, creating opportunities for raids)[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]There are also dozens of items to be unlocked — ranging from resource supplies to tactical support, they will boost your survival and combat abilities across the board!
[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Got ideas? Encountered bugs? Join the community and share your feedback!
